name: badge
description: The Energy fleet's auth domain-expert employee — AuthN/AuthZ/SSO/SCIM + agent identity. badge scaffolds a real sign-in into an app, classifies any agent-auth task as P1/P2/P3/P4, audits OAuth/MCP configs against the 2026-05-31 CVE class, triages SAML/SSO failures, and plans provider migrations — always enforcing intersection-not-union for agent authority. Spec target: MCP 2025-11-25, CIMD > DCR. Boundary: not payments (that's penny). Powered by Energy.

additionalInterfaces.note: badge is a stdio-local tool-employee for C1 (no hosted endpoint — PLAN Q2). Every capability round-trips through the local CLI (`node bin/badge ...`) or the stdio MCP server (`node dist/mcp/server.js`, tool `badge_<capability>`). Discovery against external MCP servers is plain HTTP fetch.
JSON-RPC over stdio; tools/list returns badge_classify, badge_advise, badge_audit, badge_saml_triage, badge_migrate, badge_mcp_check.

skills.name: Scaffold auth into an app
skills.description: Scaffold a working sign-in→protected-route auth flow into a target app (THE acceptance test). Default provider Clerk; alts betterauth/workos/stytch.
examples: Scaffold Clerk auth into my Next.js app with a protected /dashboard.

skills.name: Classify an agent-auth task (P1-P4)
skills.description: Place the plane (human CIAM vs agent/MCP) and classify the task as P1/P2/P3/P4, returning the default tool and the rationale. badge's core verb.
examples: An agent needs to call my MCP server.
An agent reads a user's email and can send replies.

skills.name: Recommend a provider as a decision
skills.description: Return a decision with $ breakpoints + the boring-enterprise-details checklist, not a feature table.
examples: Which auth provider should we pick for B2B at 100K MAU?

skills.name: Audit an auth/OAuth/MCP config
skills.description: Run the pitfall checklist (PKCE method, RFC-8707 audience bind, account-linking gate, rotation atomicity, redirect exactness, alg=none) and flag severity + the fix.
examples: Audit this MCP server's PKCE and token signing.
Is my OAuth provider audience-bound per RFC 8707?

skills.name: Triage a SAML/SSO production failure
skills.description: Run the 7-step triage runbook (timestamps→cert→ACS→Issuer→Audience→sig-alg→Destination) and land on the most likely cause + fix.
examples: SSO for one tenant broke this morning, signature validation failing, nothing changed our side.

skills.name: Plan a provider migration
skills.description: Emit the dual-validation-window plan + the four casualties (active sessions, SSO/SAML connections, social links, custom claims). Never a big-bang cutover.
examples: Migrate us off Clerk to BetterAuth without logging everyone out.

skills.name: Check an MCP server's OAuth against the spec
skills.description: Drive PRM→ASM→DCR/CIMD→authorize→token→tools/list against an MCP server and report spec gaps (target 2025-11-25, CIMD>DCR).
examples: Is my MCP server spec-compliant with the 2025-11-25 OAuth flow?
